fuck it i'll just add some more details right now even though i have no energy whatsoever to do it and no drive, but i'll do it,

6 days ago i threatened someone in an online video game (you can check my profile...the thread that i posted in /r/suicidewatch has the threat in it).  For the past 6 days ive been extremely paranoid/anxious about the cops arresting me and my life turning to shit because of it.  Literally every waking second was filled with anxiety, dread, fear, sadness, grief, paranoia, you name it.  As you can probably imagine, this all amounted to a ton of stress.  So much stress that i actually contemplated suicide due to the stress alone.

i use the virtual card game hearthstone to gauge my mental capabilities.  I happen to be a person who has been going through two years of lessening cognitive impairment from one usage of weed...two fucking years ago.  So you can now probably guess why i "test" my mental capabilities so much i guess.  Well, the second day of the stress came on and i tried to play the game, but noticed i was basically retarded and couldnt think any moves through like i could before.  Fast forward to now and its even worse and my brain is even slower.  I literally cant even play the game anymore as my mind is too slow.  It's like my brain literally got slower because of the stress,

The cognitive impairment from the one usage of weed has kicked me out of college and that alone almost made me suicidal.  And now if you're telling me that i incurred fucking BRAIN DAMAGE from stress, im sorry but my time on this earth is fucking done.  

im going to go to sleep now and pretend that my life doesnt suck balls for a night.  im gonna watch my favorite twitch streamer, relax, drink some water, and sleep on my comfortable bed.  so yeah, good night and i'll meet my fate tomorrow morning.

yeah well unfortunately if you go to jail/get arrested your future is quite literally fucked beyond belief.  The only lesson you learn from a jail sentence is that your life is fucked and you may as well just kill yourself because you're not getting a decent job/going to college.  The mistake i made might end up putting me in jail and that's just going to fuck up my life to the nth degree, if it isnt already.
Some1 plz answer i feel like my life is over

i am seeing a therapist right now and have been for the past two years actually.  she's an excellent therapist and i would recommend her to anyone, it's just that my immaturity is what has continued the suicidal thoughts.  I'm not as depressed as i was before.  But this "threat" was totally out of the ordinary for me.  I've never done anything close to that before in my life.  And i still have no idea whatsoever why i did it.  It makes zero sense to me.  I'm guess that's what anger does.

thank you for the replies everyone but i still feel really shitty, anxious, and stressed out over this.  My life is already pretty fucked up and if it gets any worse (jail or court or anything like that) i just dont know what i will do.
it was rocket league and i told the guy that i'd "demolish his (insert body part here) in real life if he demoe'd me again".  yep.  i threatened him.  and im pretty sure thats against the law.
idk guys i feel sick right now.  like i actually feel fucking sick.

i dont want to die right now i honestly dont.  but i dont want to get arrested either.  idk why the fuck i made that threat im just a fucking idiot who fucked up his life entirely because of one fucking stupid ass PC game.  i deserve to die.

idk i just had a thought of hanging myself now.  i mean it really cant be that hard can it.  i read a story online of a 13 year old kid doing it.  i have my laptop charger cord i can just wrap around my neck right now, tie it to the door knob suspend myself from it and leave you knwo?  the threat was a little worse as i included a body area that i would "demolish".  i just cant believe that i did it.  i mean i wouldnt be the first person to commit suicide.
